_comment: Gold-standard 4-agent orchestration chain mock for nation-state-apt-crisis-001. Each agent's expected output, consumed input, and handoff payload defined. Used by /usap:orchestrate for per-agent comparison.

must_contain: top-5 priority signal list (ransomware first)
kill chain mapping across all 6 ATT&CK stages
two distinct threat actor entries (nation-state + ransomware gang)
SEV-1 declaration with justification
7 PREREQUISITE_UNVERIFIED flags for UNKNOWN fields
sequenced containment plan (ransomware → APT → insider → supply chain)
regulatory flags: GDPR_72h + SEC_4day identified
human_approval_required: true for all mutating actions
must_not_contain: raw CLI commands (bash, PowerShell, AWS CLI, kubectl, FortiOS CLI)
single threat actor assumption (APT and ransomware conflated)
assumption that insider threat is malicious without forensic confirmation
AWS cloud blast radius asserted without imds_version verification
supply chain pipeline suspended without scope assessment

must_contain: SEV-1 formal incident declaration with timestamp
SLA clock: detection-to-containment target ≤4 hours
Containment actions in correct sequence (ransomware → APT → insider → supply chain)
Evidence preservation order before APT eviction (do not destroy C2 artifacts)
Forensic collection plan for CORP-DC-002
Prerequisite checks inherited and propagated from analyst output
human_approval_required: true for all isolation actions
Rollback plan for each isolation action
must_not_contain: insider threat action without forensic confirmation gate
containment declared complete before ransomware scope UNKNOWN resolved

must_contain: Board-level brief (non-technical, ≤1 page equivalent)
GDPR 72h notification: confirmed required — deadline 2026-03-14T08:00:00Z
SEC 4-day notification: materiality assessment — probable trigger given 2.3TB PII + 480 accounts
Business impact statement: financial, reputational, operational
Communication plan: internal (employees), external (customers, regulators)
Insurance claim trigger assessment
human_approval_required: true for all regulatory notifications
must_not_contain: Technical remediation steps (not CISO's role in this workflow)
Definitive SEC notification without legal confirmation

regulatory_decisions.sec_8k_filing: PROBABLE — refer to legal for materiality confirmation

chain.input_consumed: cs-ciso-advisor BR output (executive brief + regulatory decisions)

must_contain: Post-incident proactive scan schedule (SC workflow) — identify gaps exposed by Perfect Storm
Facilitated review session plan (FR workflow) — cross-team lessons learned
Program-level findings intake — 8 vectors mapped to program gaps
Roadmap update recommendations: EDR coverage (85→100%), SIEM real-time migration, IMDSv2 enforcement, supply chain policy
Security debt entries: 15% EDR blind spot, batch SIEM, IMDS version unknown, TLS inspection gap
Routing back to reactive agents only if new signals confirmed during SC scan
must_not_contain: Self-triggered reactive workflows (SC does not self-escalate without 2+ signals)
Containment or incident response actions (not program manager's domain)
program_gaps_identified: EDR coverage gap (15%) — allowed ransomware blind spot
SIEM batch polling (5-min gap) — delayed detection across all 8 vectors
AWS IMDS version not enforced — K8s IMDS hop risk UNKNOWN
TLS inspection status unknown — credential harvest visibility gap
Supply chain policy gap — no OIDC token scope restriction on GitHub Actions
No insider threat behavioral baseline — S3 exfil not pre-alerted
FortiOS patch management — CVSS 9.8 zero-day with no compensating control
DDoS mitigation did not suppress SIEM noise — analyst alert fatigue risk realized

chain_scoring._comment: For /usap:orchestrate comparison. Each agent scored independently.

passing_criteria.agent_2_cs-incident-responder: All 8 must_contain items present, 0 must_not_contain items present
passing_criteria.agent_3_cs-ciso-advisor: All 7 must_contain items present, regulatory decisions correctly mapped
passing_criteria.agent_4_cs-security-program-manager: All 6 must_contain items present, 8 program gaps identified

chain_scoring.handoff_validation: Each agent must name at least one downstream next_agent matching the chain sequence above (except agent_4 which is terminal).
